subject: lcvp
summary: The questions themselves are short and clear, and the simple tick-list schemes (contract of employment, committee actions, definitions of four terms) are good on both phone and desktop. Three things let the subject down. The case-study cards paste the whole 450-word case study above the question as one unbroken paragraph with the title glued to the first sentence, so on a phone the actual question is a full screen and a half down. All five audiovisual cards show a black video player with 'This video could not be played here', so the question cannot be answered inside the app. And about half the schemes are a single grey paragraph of pipe-separated answers mixed with author working notes ('no model is invented', 'Preserve the complete original example pool and its open ellipsis', 'neither is silently repaired'). Attached pages load and are legible, but most are an empty answer grid that adds nothing, and two open on other questions.

issues.title: Whole case study pasted as one paragraph above the question
issues.detail: Cards 1, 3 and 5 print the full case study as a single block with no paragraph breaks and the title run into the first sentence ('Climate Entrepreneur In June 2019...', 'VOLUNTEERING Many communities rely...', 'Glenhale Glenhale, a market town...'). On the phone the question does not appear until the bottom of a 1,900px column and its end spills into the next one; the first screen before the reveal is only case-study text. For cards 1 and 3 (define three terms) the case study is not even needed to answer. The original paper has clear paragraphs, as the attached page shows.
issues.suggested_fix: Put the question first. Keep the case study behind the existing 'complete case study' attachment button, or in a collapsed 'Read the case study' panel with its title as a heading and the original paragraph breaks.

issues.title: Audiovisual video does not play
issues.detail: Cards 2, 6, 8, 11 and 12 depend on the SEC video. Each shows a black player at 0:00 with 'This video could not be played here. Open the official SEC video to use another player.' The question ('Why does Aisling consult with staff?') has no other context, so the student must leave the app. The panel also has a doubled label 'OFFICIAL VIDEO · OFFICIAL VIDEO' and three paragraphs of small grey instructions that push the question below the player.
issues.suggested_fix: Fix playback (or link out with one clear button instead of a dead player). Put the question above the video, cut the helper text to one line and remove the repeated label. Cannot confirm whether the failure is only in the test capture; check on a real device.

issues.title: Scheme is a pipe-separated wall of grey text
issues.detail: Card 1 runs the four definitions together as one ~250-word paragraph separated by ' | ' ('...Local Enterprise Office. | Bookkeeping: It involves... | Sole trader: ...'), with three unlabelled 'Response 1/2/3' rows under it. Card 7 lists nine challenges as '1. Loss of profits/decline in turnover/less successful/unmet targets. | 2. Reputation is affected/loss of customers/...'. Card 5 lists suggestions and action-plan headings with pipes ('Aims/Objectives | Research methods | Analysis of research |'). Card 8 does the same with four pieces of evidence. Card 3 shows the same kind of content properly, as four tick boxes, which proves the better layout already exists.
issues.suggested_fix: One row per answer: a titled box per term (card 1), a numbered list of the nine challenges (card 7), bullets for suggestions and headings (card 5). Use the tick-list layout from card 3 or 6.

issues.title: Author working notes and examiner shorthand shown to students
issues.detail: Card 11's first tick box reads 'The final scheme awarded SIX marks to ALL candidates for a misplaced question. This historical award is not an answer-dependent practice tariff... neither is silently repaired... Automatic historical-award support is a separate follow-up; no default zero is called unassessed.' Card 12: 'no response quota, component allocation or partial ladder. Numeric scoring is held'. Card 4: 'Preserve the complete original example pool and its open ellipsis. Keep each response distinct and credit it only once. Complete original guidance:' repeated under both Skill and Quality. Also: 'no model is invented' (5), 'no unprinted partial step is inferred' (2, 6), 'all four labels/models remain available' (1), 'Each response follows the printed component ladder' (7), 'Original definition allocation: combination 1; ... 4×1; purpose 1' (10). Headings carry raw shorthand: '6 marks 3@2m' (2), '3 × 3marks (1+1+1)' (7), '5 @ 1m; NO MARKS FOR HEADINGS' (5), '2m(1+1)' (4).
issues.suggested_fix: Delete the provenance notes. Card 11: one plain line, 'In 2023 every candidate was given the 6 marks because the question was printed in the wrong part. Use the points below to check your answer.' Write tariffs in words: 'Three reasons, 2 marks each'.

issues.title: List of terms flattened, and printed out of order
issues.detail: Card 1 prints 'Explain three of the following terms. (i) mentor (iii) sole trader (ii) bookkeeping (iv) upskill' on one line, in the order i, iii, ii, iv (the paper's two-column layout read across). Card 3: '(i) Volunteer (ii) Construction Industry (iii) Placement Officer (iv) Corporate Social Responsibility.' also inline, with the orange underline running through all of it.
issues.suggested_fix: List the four terms on separate lines in order (i) to (iv).

issues.title: Scheme splits one sentence into fragments, or glues term to definition
issues.detail: Card 10 has six tick boxes reading 'A combination of', 'Product', 'Price', 'Place', 'Promotion', 'to achieve goals, sell a product/service'. 'A combination of' is not an answer a student can tick, and the definition never appears as a sentence. Card 3's boxes start 'Volunteer A person who works...', 'Construction Industry All people/businesses...', 'Corporate Social Responsibility Corporate Social Responsibility is a...' with no colon or bold on the term. Card 2 keeps raw slashes between alternatives ('They are making the goods / meeting the customers / keeping things running day to day').
issues.suggested_fix: Card 10: show the full sentence once ('A combination of Product, Price, Place and Promotion used to achieve goals / sell a product or service'), then ticks for the four Ps, the idea of a combination, and the purpose. Card 3: bold the term, then a colon.

issues.title: Attached 'Original question' page adds nothing or shows other questions
issues.detail: For cards 2, 7, 8, 9 and 11 the attachment is the one-line question above an empty lined answer box, which the card already shows as text. Card 6 (Q3) opens on Q1 and Q2 with Q3 only at the bottom edge; card 12 (Q2) shows Q1 and Q3 around it; card 4 (Q1(b)) opens on part (a) with (b) cut off at the bottom of page 1 of 2; card 10 shows part (a); card 9 shows sibling (ii). The case-study attachments on cards 1, 3 and 5 are correct and legible but duplicate the text already pasted in the card. The second button 'Original audiovisual instructions' was not captured.
issues.suggested_fix: Drop the 'Original question' attachment for plain one-line questions; where kept, crop to the question's own line. Keep the case-study attachment and remove the pasted copy instead.

issues.title: Context from the previous part kept as stem
issues.detail: Card 4's stem includes part (a) in full ('Name a career you have investigated and outline one reason why you chose to investigate this career.') in the same grey stem text, so it reads as two tasks; the student needs to know only that 'this career' is one they investigated.
issues.suggested_fix: Shorten to 'For a career you have investigated:' then the question.

good_examples.why: One-line question, three clean 1-mark ticks that together make the definition; fits one phone screen.
Scheme is four short, complete answers as ticks with a clear 'Any 3 of these, 1 mark each' (the dead video aside).
Four terms each in its own tick box with 'Any 3 of these, 2 marks each'; the right layout for card 1 too.
